Marta (CS): Hi everyone — kicking off Crestline onboarding. Quick intro: Crestline will use Redwood Dedicated for their public-facing chat and Redwood Optimize for cost tuning. Primary goals: predictable <20ms p95 on short queries, SLA-ready logs, and SSO + audit trail. 30/60/90 goals below.
Priya (AE): Thanks Marta. Who are our Crestline stakeholders? I have Caitlin (ops) and Ben (security) on my side.
Caitlin (Crestline): Yep that's right — I'm the day-to-day ops lead. Ben will join on security/SSO. Also looping in product: Ravi is our PM contact.
Ravi (PM): Hey! My priorities: 1) smooth data onboarding for context retrieval, 2) rollout plan for customer-facing pilot (10 users), 3) contract questions around Dedicated throughput.
Ethan (Solutions): Noted. Technical owners please confirm: does Crestline already have SAML IdP? That affects SSO work. Also need approximate corpus size for embedding batch.
Caitlin (Crestline): We use Okta already. Corpus is ~120k docs (PDFs + internal KB, mostly <5k tokens each).
Lena (Eng): 120k docs — we'll want to sample for token distribution. For Dedicated sizing we'll estimate peak qps. Can someone share expected concurrent users for pilot?
Caitlin (Crestline): Pilot: 10 agents, ~30 concurrent users during peak support hours. Production target: 200 concurrent.
Sam (CS Ops): Calendar note: Proposed kickoff meeting tomorrow 10:30 PT — 30m. Agenda: stakeholder intros (5m), success criteria (5m), data access & SSO plan (10m), timeline & owners (10m). Works?
Priya (AE): Works for me. Can we add a quick item for renewal/expansion signals? Crestline has renewal in 11 months — want to tie milestones to expansion criteria.
Marta (CS): Good call. Success criteria (draft):
- Performance: p95 latency on chat <20ms for <128-token queries, 99.9% availability for Dedicated endpoints
- Quality: pass 80% of internal eval prompt set above baseline LLM model X on intent accuracy
- Ops: SSO enabled + audit logs streaming to Crestline SIEM
- Cost: baseline unit cost under $0.004/token equivalent (post-optimize recommendations)
Ethan (Solutions): I'll take Performance and Ops for the pilot. Lena will help on sizing.
Lena (Eng): Confirmed — I'll run an initial capacity calc. Need sample traffic trace and a few representative prompts.
Caitlin (Crestline): I'll share a sanitized sample dataset and our support scripts by EOD. How should I upload?
Marta (CS): Please drop into the secure S3 bucket we provisioned. Caitlin, I'll DM creds and S3 path.
OnboardBot: calendar invite created: Crestline Onboarding Kickoff — Tomorrow 10:30 PT (30m).
Sam (CS Ops): Quick risk flags:
- Data readiness delay (high) — can block evals
- SSO misconfig (medium) — can push pilot by 1-2 weeks
- Production capacity mismatch (medium) — needs early load test
Priya (AE): For renewal alignment: propose milestones to trigger expansion conversation: 30d initial health check, 60d SLA + quality pass, 120d usage >50% of committed throughput.
Marta (CS): Action items assigned:
- Marta: DM S3 creds to Caitlin + share onboarding checklist (today)
- Caitlin: Upload sanitized sample dataset (EOD)
- Lena + Ethan: Preliminary capacity calc (48h)
- Sam: Send calendar invite + meeting notes template (today)
- Priya: Draft renewal milestone doc and share with finance (3 days)
- Ravi: confirm internal stakeholders and Ben's availability for security review (EOD)
Caitlin (Crestline): Sounds good. One ask — can we get a brief runbook for fallback if Dedicated region has an outage?
Ethan (Solutions): Yes — we'll include a fallback plan: auto-route to hosted instance in EU region with degraded throughput but preserved state. Will add to runbook.
Marta (CS): Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the 10:30 PT kickoff and we can start the checklist. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: if you can make it or reply with an alternative slot.
Priya (AE): :thumbsup:
Lena (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sam (CS Ops): :thumbsup:
Ravi (PM): :thumbsup:
Caitlin (Crestline): :thumbsup:
Marta (CS): Thanks all — excited to kick this off. I'll post the meeting notes + task board after the call.
OnboardBot: Meeting notes doc created: /redwood/onboards/crestline/kickoff-notes.md
